investigations.name: draft-to-living-cell
investigations.title: From Draft to Living Cell
investigations.question: The paper treats a biological interface as a scientific object — something you can compose with other entities, swap the mechanism behind, and watch emerge from the inside. Does that hold in executable form? Across nine composition patterns this investigation asks three things about the interface. COMPOSE — when one typed interface is coupled to other entities, outward to a nutrient field and to neighbouring cells and inward to a metabolism and a membrane, does the composition produce the emergent consequence the paper predicts (niche construction, competition, cross-feeding, pattern, division), on genuine simulation output rather than a scripted trajectory? SWAP — is the same interface substitutable, so the externally observable relation survives when the mechanism behind it is replaced (dynamic-FBA by a lumped Michaelis-Menten kinetic) — and does that hold at more than one level of composition, not just inside a single cell? EMERGE — can a cell's boundary itself be an emergent product of its own internal processes, produced and maintained from the inside rather than merely given? The subject is the interface; process bigraphs (Vivarium) are the example substrate we use to make it executable.
investigations.hypothesis: An interface is a property of a composition, not of any single mechanism behind it, and the three moves the paper makes with it are all executable. COMPOSE: coupling one typed interface to other entities — outward to an environment and neighbours, inward to a metabolism and a membrane — yields emergent behaviour the interface alone does not have, and every study measures such a consequence on genuine simulation output. SWAP: where the same interface is realized by two different mechanisms the observable relation is preserved — approached as surrogate calibration (a tuned Michaelis-Menten twin agrees within ~10% on the condition it was tuned on) at two levels, the single-cell metabolism and the multi-cell colony, with held-out generalization and the remaining levels an explicit, honestly-flagged frontier. EMERGE: a cell's boundary can be produced and sustained by internal composition — a membrane that runs its own maintenance persists, while the identical membrane without that process decays — the interface made, not assumed. Each study is a behavior-gated test of one of these claims.

investigations.name: paper-figures
investigations.title: Executable Figures
investigations.question: The meta-modeler's guide argues its case through eleven figures — each a BioRender illustration (panel a) paired with a process-bigraph diagram (panel b) that names the composition behind the biology. Are those diagrams merely drawn, or are they executable? This investigation asks one thing of every figure in the paper: does a runnable process-bigraph composite reproduce, under a behavior-gated test, the exact principle the figure's caption asserts — a process reading and writing typed ports (Fig 1), multi-timescale orchestration (Fig 2), a cellular interface that responds to its inputs (Fig 3), an environment that drives those ports (Fig 4), a viability crossing that swaps the active grain (Fig 5), a molecular mechanism exchanging through typed physical channels (Fig 6), nested hierarchical composites (Fig 7), a cellular interface that emerges from self-maintaining processes (Fig 8), division as a compositional rewrite (Fig 9), cells reorganizing into a collective (Fig 10), and a population evolving toward a selection optimum (Fig 11)? The subject is the figure; the claim is that the paper's diagrams run.
investigations.hypothesis:
A TWO-LEVEL hypothesis, with separate verdicts (rewritten per the Oct-2026 scientific review, which asked us to stop conflating structural executability with mechanistic emergence).
H1 (structural executability) — every panel-b diagram in the paper denotes a real, runnable, typed process-bigraph composition: for each of the eleven figures there is a `figNN-runnable` composite that builds through the workspace `build_core`, runs to completion through the engine, and reproduces the caption's stated principle under a behavior-gated test on genuine simulation output. REFUTED IF any figure's composite fails to build/run, or its behavior gate fails, or the readout it reports is not actually produced by the composition (e.g. a value hard-wired rather than computed).
H2 (mechanistic emergence) — SELECTED figures additionally exhibit behaviour that ARISES from mechanistic coupling (shared internal state, conservation, feedback, derived rather than imposed quantities), not solely from imposed rules or a scripted schedule. This is tested only by the `figNN-mechanistic` variants (scientific-review revision), each with counterfactual/ablation controls and quantitative diagnostics. REFUTED FOR A FIGURE IF, under matched-null controls, the claimed behaviour persists when the proposed mechanism is removed (so the behaviour was scripted), or if a conservation/identity the mechanism should enforce fails, or if a quantity presented as derived is in fact an imposed constant.
The two levels get SEPARATE verdicts: H1 is a software/behavioral claim (currently met for all eleven); H2 is a scientific claim met only where a mechanistic variant demonstrates it (in progress — fig-06 and fig-04 established, the rest under revision). The calibrated, spatially-resolved counterparts of these patterns live in the sibling investigation `draft-to-living-cell`.
